description_en: Queries the list of AI models under a specified AgentTeams instance. You can filter by model name or provider name and use paging
description_zh: 用于查询指定 AgentTeams 实例下的 AI 模型列表，支持按模型名称、供应商名称过滤，并支持分页查询
kebab_example: aliyun agentteams list-models --instance-id AgentTeams --max-results 20 --next-token nt-xxx --provider-name my-provider --name worker-demo --id m-xxx --region cn-hangzhou
